name: CRAFFT 2.1+N
sourceInstrument: CRAFFT Substance Use Assessment (user-supplied reproduction text); the extra quit item in the supplied text is retained as an unscored supplement, not counted as one of the standard six CRAFFT items.
directions: Past 12 months for frequency items; lifetime for the CAR question; past month for nicotine items. Intended for ages 12–21.
timeframe: Past 12 months for frequency items; lifetime for the CAR question; past month for nicotine items. Intended for ages 12–21.

questions.text: Drink more than a few sips of beer, wine, or any drink containing alcohol?
Use any marijuana (cannabis, weed, oil, wax, or hash by smoking, vaping, dabbing, or in edibles) or "synthetic marijuana" (like "K2," "Spice")?
Use anything else to get high (like other illegal drugs, pills, prescription or over-the-counter medications, and things that you sniff, huff, vape, or inject)?
Use a vaping device\ containing nicotine and/or flavors, or use any tobacco products?
Have you ever ridden in a CAR driven by someone (including yourself) who was "high" or had been using alcohol or drugs?
Do you ever use alcohol or drugs to RELAX, feel better about yourself, or fit in?
Do you ever use alcohol or drugs while you are by yourself, or ALONE?
Do you ever FORGET things you did while using alcohol or drugs?
Do your FAMILY or FRIENDS ever tell you that you should cut down on your drinking or drug use?
Have you ever gotten into TROUBLE while you were using alcohol or drugs?

parts.name: Additional user-supplied item · not part of CRAFFT score

questions.text: Have you ever tried to quit using, but couldn't?
questions.criterionNote: Additional item in supplied text; excluded from the validated CRAFFT 6-item score.

questions.text: Do you vape or use tobacco now because it is really hard to quit?
Have you ever felt like you were addicted to vaping or tobacco?
Do you ever have strong cravings to vape or use tobacco?
Have you ever felt like you really needed to vape or use tobacco?
Is it hard to keep from vaping or using tobacco in places where you are not supposed to, like school?
When you haven't vaped or used tobacco in a while (or when you tried to stop using), did you find it hard to concentrate because you couldn't vape or use tobacco?
When you haven't vaped or used tobacco in a while (or when you tried to stop using), did you feel more irritable because you couldn't vape or use tobacco?
When you haven't vaped or used tobacco in a while (or when you tried to stop using), did you feel a strong need or urge to vape or use tobacco?
When you haven't vaped or used tobacco in a while (or when you tried to stop using), did you feel nervous, restless, or anxious because you couldn't vape or use tobacco?

groups.name: CRAFFT 6-item score
groups.positiveLabel: Screen positive; brief assessment and intervention are indicated.

interpretationNote: This form and scoring profile were entered from user-supplied material. Results are screening or descriptive information only and do not establish a diagnosis.
